description: Profit and loss at expiry for a US-style equity, ETF or index option position built from 1 to 4 option legs, in US dollars with the standard contract multiplier of 100 shares (NOT Deribit and not coin-settled: for BTC/ETH options on Deribit use workflow.run_spread_payoff or workflow.run_options_payoff). Each leg: call or put, long or short, strike, premium per share as quoted, contracts. Optional `stock` adds long shares held with the options (covered call, protective put, collar). Prices are the ones you pass in; nothing is fetched. All legs share one expiry (a calendar spread is not computed). Returns: the strategy name derived from the legs (bull/bear call or put spread, iron condor, iron butterfly, straddle, strangle, covered call, protective put, collar, single leg, or a custom position), net debit or credit in dollars, maxProfitUsd and maxLossUsd (null = unlimited), every breakeven price per share, the P&L at each price in `scenarioPrices` and a short exact payoff curve. maxLossUsd is the worst P&L as a loss amount (negative if no price loses); maxProfitUsd is the best P&L (negative if every price loses).

legs.description: One to four option legs. Each leg: { optionType: call|put, position: long|short, strike: number, premium: number (USD per share), contracts: integer >= 1 (default 1) }.

contracts.description: Number of contracts, a whole number from 1. Default 1.

premium.description: Premium per share as quoted, USD, 0 or more. A contract covers 100 shares, so a 4.50 premium costs 450 dollars per contract.

strike.description: Strike price, USD per share, above 0

scenarioPrices.description: Expiry prices (USD per share, 0 or more) to report the position P&L at. Optional.

stock.description: Optional long shares held together with the options: { quantity: whole shares, costPerShare: USD }. 100 shares cover one short call.

name: workflow.run_options_position
title: Options Position
